state: First-unit service fixture: lid/coil carrier removed, board restrained in an insulating fixture, underside accessible. Attach all probes with mains isolated and both DC buses measured discharged. No hand-held live probing.

signals.name: HOT5
signals.method: paired microprobes at exposed capacitor pad toes

signals.name: V15 gate supply
signals.method: paired microprobes at exposed capacitor pad toes
signals.power_state: isolated low-voltage injection; reference is LEG_RET

signals.name: HOT5 divider
signals.method: high-impedance microprobe; characterize probe loading on divider
signals.power_state: low-voltage injection; vary HOT5 independently of V15

signals.name: HOT5_OK
signals.method: 0.2mm fixture microprobe on outward SOT23 pad toe; no clip lead

signals.name: BUS_FAULT_HOT
signals.method: 0.2mm fixture microprobe on outward SOT23 pad toe

signals.name: BUS_FAULT
signals.method: mating breakout connector preferred; underside annulus is fixture alternative
signals.power_state: controller SELV supply, then isolated gate supply

signals.name: PERMIT
signals.method: mating breakout connector preferred; assert only under interlocked test sequence

signals.name: CT positive trip
signals.method: fixture microprobe; injected isolated CT stimulus

signals.name: CT negative trip
signals.method: fixture microprobe; injected isolated CT stimulus

signals.name: Kelvin differential
signals.method: paired low-noise differential microprobes; no common ground tie across terminals
signals.power_state: cold resistance/current injection first; energized bus only in rated interlocked fixture
